title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private installer (Helm + Terraform)
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: make tenant bootstrap and RBAC provisioning for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem installer) fully automatable and idempotent across Helm and Terraform installation flows. This PR introduces an automation-friendly RBAC bundle and helper scripts so installer flows (private-installer, helm charts, and the terraform module) can create minimal tenant bootstrap roles and bindings with least-privilege defaults and audit annotations. Changes include: 1) a consolidated 'automation-tenant-bootstrap' policy bundle (ClusterRole/Role + RoleBinding templates) that supports scoped tenant namespaces and tenant-scoped service accounts; 2) Terraform resource templates and outputs to wire bootstrap identities into the private-installer module; 3) Helm chart hooks and values to optionally apply the bootstrap bundle during install/upgrade and to enable a dry-run / validate-only mode; 4) unit and integration test manifests for the installer CI to validate idempotency and rollback behavior; 5) docs and CLI snippets for operators. The intent is to cover common Private deployment patterns where operators want to automate tenant creation while preserving auditability and separation of privileges. See the commits list for per-change details and files_changed for an overview. Checklist: [x] automation bundle added [x] Terraform templates and outputs [x] Helm chart hooks + values [x] tests and CI updates [x] documentation and upgrade notes [x] security review addressed

Priya Nair (author): Updated templates to split cluster-level operations vs namespace-scoped bindings and removed wildcard verbs. Added detailed capability table in README explaining why certain cluster actions are required for initial bootstrap.

Sofia Patel: Need an idempotency test that covers repeated helm upgrades with automation.bootstrap.enabled=true. Also request that the helm hook job honors TTLSecondsAfterFinished so failed jobs don't linger.
Priya Nair (author): Added tests/installer/tenant-bootstrap-idempotency.yaml and changed hook job to set TTLSecondsAfterFinished=300. CI pipeline updated to re-run flaky job up to 2 times.
Ravi Kumar: Security review: ensure bootstrap SA keys are rotated and stored in KMS-backed secrets; document manual revoke flow. Also request audit annotations on all bindings.
Priya Nair (author): Added secret creation to Terraform module to optionally use KMS secret provider (documented) and embedded audit annotations on RoleBindings. Marked security review resolved.
